breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses ICHARG=0 instead of ICHARG=11 for the HSE calculation step. It explicitly explains the reasoning that ICHARG must be ≤10 when starting a hybrid functional calculation from an existing WAVECAR so the charge density is recomputed. This matches the ground truth prompt which specifies ICHARG=0.
